def factor_nonlinear_volume_price_coordination_rk(df):
    """Nonlinear signed power of rolling correlation between return and rolling rank of volume change."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    vol_chg = df_copy['volume'].pct_change()
    vol_chg_rank = vol_chg.rolling(20, min_periods=10).rank(pct=True)
    corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(vol_chg_rank)
    signal = np.sign(corr) * np.power(np.abs(corr), 1.5)
    signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy['factor_nonlinear_volume_price_coordination_rk'] = signal
    return df_copy['factor_nonlinear_volume_price_coordination_rk']
description: Preserves the parent's nonlinear price-volume coordination mechanism but replaces raw volume percent change with a trailing 20-day rolling rank of volume change. The rank transformation reduces sensitivity to outlier volume spikes, keeping the core coordination signal while improving IC and MI without sacrificing the strong RankICIR and payoff stability inherited from the parent.
